created_from: 2026-10-04 audit of SU2 full-horizon run 37160281461 and rejected control-only continuation 37179161618

prior_completed_baseline.completion: 50 updates, solver exit 0, 48/50 inner-residual steps; local quality UNCERTAIN

rejected_old_baseline_continuation.reason: Rebuild had a different immutable image ID and different rootfs layers; do not pair it with the old baseline despite equality of the measured solver binary, patched source, package-version list, compiler, source and recipe.

jobs.name: baseline
jobs.actions: Build and measure one fresh immutable image, run the frozen baseline only, save that exact image with docker save, then upload image and complete-or-partial baseline evidence.

jobs.name: control
jobs.actions: Download and docker-load the baseline job's image archive, require exact image-ID and measured receipt equality, run the frozen control only, independently review both raw cases, then upload the combined evidence.

execution.comparison: Both fresh cases must use the same saved image bytes and immutable ID. The old archived baseline is not part of this matched pair.

acceptance.execution: Each solver exits 0, records all 50 unique physical updates, and passes the frozen reported-time consistency check.
acceptance.runtime: Loaded control image ID and all measured receipt fields exactly equal the baseline image receipt.
acceptance.review: tools/review_su2_full_horizon_cfl_pair.py recomputes both cases from raw completed outputs and reports per-step residual convergence separately from frozen sampled quality thresholds.
limits: A complete numerical run does not imply local-quality PASS.
Sampled grid derivatives do not certify continuous extrema.
Neither run can establish singularity, molecular alignment, deterministic particle positions, or a constitutive viscosity change.

stopping_rules: Never run CFL=100 from a rebuilt image paired with the historical CFL=10 result.
Never start control if baseline did not complete and its exact image archive and receipt were not uploaded.
Never accept a partial run, timeout, or changed image as a completed pair.
